DECLARE
 lv_app_user VARCHAR2(200);
 lv_audit_event VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 synchronize;
 
 globalvar.workstation := webutil_clientinfo.get_host_name;
 
 IF globalvar.auth_type = 'CAC' THEN
 lv_app_user := GLOBALVAR.CAC_APP_USER;
 lv_audit_event := 'DOD Monitoring Acceptance';
 ELSIF globalvar.auth_type = 'OKTA' THEN
 lv_app_user := GLOBALVAR.OKTA_APP_USER;
 lv_audit_event := 'OKTA Successful Login';
 END IF;
 
 login_core.log_login_event(
 APP_USER => lv_app_user,
 WORKSTATION => GLOBALVAR.WORKSTATION,
 AUDIT_EVENT => lv_audit_event
 );
 
 :dual.un := lv_app_user;

 set_item_property('dual.un', required, property_false);
 set_item_property('dual.pw', required, property_false);
 
 empty_edi;

 
 IF login_core.is_user_expired(lv_app_user)THEN
 password_message (globalvar.err_not_authorized); -- 'You are not authorized to access the system';
 EXIT_BC_APP(lv_app_user, globalvar.err_not_authorized);
 END IF;
 
 lt_user_session.set_userid(lv_app_user); 
 get_session;
 call_menu_form;
END;

DECLARE
 lv_auth_type VARCHAR2(50);
 lv_status VARCHAR2(50);
 lv_status_msg VARCHAR2(2000);
 lv_reset_request VARCHAR2(10);
 lv_app_user VARCHAR2(50);
 lb_limit_reached BOOLEAN; 
 ex_login_err EXCEPTION;

 PROCEDURE SIMPLE_AUTH_CHECKS IS

 BEGIN
 login_core.handle_simple_authentication( userid_in => :DUAL.UN, 
 pwd_in => :DUAL.PW,
 workstation_in => GLOBALVAR.workstation,
 status_out => lv_status,
 status_msg => lv_status_msg);
 
 IF lv_status = 'ERROR' THEN -- Invalid user/Password, User Expired, User Locked
 password_message(lv_status_msg);
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, lv_status_msg); 
 ELSIF lv_status = 'LOGIN_ERR' THEN
 password_message(lv_status_msg); 
 
 lb_limit_reached := LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.PWD_LOCKOUT_LIMIT_REACHED(:DUAL.UN);
 
 IF lb_limit_reached THEN
 password_message(GLOBALVAR.err_user_is_locked);
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, GLOBALVAR.err_user_is_locked);
 ELSE
 RAISE ex_login_err;
 END IF; 
 
 ELSIF lv_status = 'RESET_REQD' THEN
 -- RESET required to proceed.
 -- Possible scenarios: 
 --1) RESET_REQUEST set 
 --2) STRONG PASSWORD POLICY NOT MET.
 --3) PASSWORD EXPIRED
 
 GO_ITEM ('DUAL.PW');
 password_message (lv_status_msg);
 
 lt_user_session.set_userid(:DUAL.UN);
 login_core.set_pwd_updated_status(FALSE);
 CALL_FORM (LOWER ('UTWPASWD')); 
 
 IF NOT login_core.get_pwd_updated_status THEN
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, 'Password Reset Required.');
 END IF;


 
 ELSIF lv_status = 'PWD_EXPIRE_WARNING' THEN
 DECLARE
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
 BEGIN 
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_alert'); 
 -- 'Your Application Password will will expire in '||to_char(no_of_days_to_expire)||' days. Do you want to change your password now ?' ); -- MLT# 545
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, lv_status_msg);
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 lt_user_session.set_userid(:DUAL.UN);
 call_form( lower('UTWPASWD') ,no_hide ,no_replace ,no_query_only);
 end if; 
 END;
 END IF; 
 END SIMPLE_AUTH_CHECKS;
 
 PROCEDURE CAC_AUTH_CHECKS IS
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
 al_button NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO ln_cnt
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :DUAL.un AND edi_pn_id IS NOT NULL;

 IF ln_cnt > 0 THEN
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY
 ('EDIPN_WARN',
 alert_message_text,
 GLOBALVAR.err_card_already_assigned --'The user already has authentication card assigned - Operation not allowed' -- V28
 );
 al_button := SHOW_ALERT ('EDIPN_WARN');
 
 IF al_button = alert_button1 THEN
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, GLOBALVAR.err_card_already_assigned);
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END CAC_AUTH_CHECKS;
 
BEGIN
 globalvar.workstation := webutil_clientinfo.get_host_name;
 
 IF GLOBALVAR.AUTH_TYPE = 'AD' THEN
 login_core.handle_ad_authentication( userid_in => :DUAL.UN, 
 pwd_in => :DUAL.PW,
 workstation_in => GLOBALVAR.workstation,
 status_out => lv_status,
 status_msg => lv_status_msg,
 app_user => lv_app_user); -- only for OK and LOGIN_ERR status
 IF lv_status = 'ERROR' THEN
 password_message(lv_status_msg);
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, lv_status_msg);
 ELSIF lv_status = 'LOGIN_ERR' THEN
 password_message(lv_status_msg); 
 
 lb_limit_reached := LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.PWD_LOCKOUT_LIMIT_REACHED(app_user => NULL, ad_user => :DUAL.UN);
 
 IF lb_limit_reached THEN
 password_message(GLOBALVAR.err_9412); --Password attempt exceeds. This may lock your network account.
 EXIT_BC_APP(:DUAL.UN, GLOBALVAR.err_9412);
 ELSE
 CLEAR_FORM;
 :DUAL.DOD := GLOBALVAR.cac_login_letter;
 GO_ITEM('DUAL.UN');
 END IF; 
 ELSIF lv_status = 'OK' THEN
 IF NOT lt_password_policy.check_hash ( lv_app_user, :DUAL.PW) THEN
 update_ltuser_pwd(lv_app_user);
 END IF;
 
 LT_USER_SESSION.SET_USERID(lv_app_user);
 GET_SESSION;
 
 CALL_MENU_FORM; 
 ELSIF lv_status = 'MUL_APP_USERS' THEN
 SET_LT_USERS;
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 SHOW_WINDOW('W_LT_USERS');

 ELSIF lv_status = 'SKIPPED' THEN
 -- handle it like SIMPLE authentication.
 SIMPLE_AUTH_CHECKS;
 
 LT_USER_SESSION.SET_USERID(:DUAL.UN);
 GET_SESSION;
 
 MULTI_CHAPTER_CHECK; 
 END IF;
 ELSIF GLOBALVAR.AUTH_TYPE = 'CAC' THEN
 -- Only a NEW USER will be able to press this button.
 -- Register APP USER with EDI.
 SIMPLE_AUTH_CHECKS;
 
 CAC_AUTH_CHECKS;
 
 UPDATE SYSTEM_USERS 
 SET edi_pn_id = (SELECT evalue FROM edi WHERE ename = :PARAMETER.P_UID) -- ONE REC ONLY.
 WHERE user_id = :DUAL.UN;

 EMPTY_EDI;

 LT_USER_SESSION.SET_USERID(:DUAL.UN);
 GET_SESSION;
 
 MULTI_CHAPTER_CHECK;
 
 ELSIF GLOBALVAR.AUTH_TYPE = 'SIMPLE' THEN 
 SIMPLE_AUTH_CHECKS; 
 
 LT_USER_SESSION.SET_USERID(:DUAL.UN);
 GET_SESSION;
 
 MULTI_CHAPTER_CHECK;
 END IF;
 
 

EXCEPTION
 WHEN ex_login_err THEN
 CLEAR_FORM;
 :DUAL.DOD := GLOBALVAR.cac_login_letter;
 GO_ITEM('DUAL.UN');
 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 
 
 
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-LIST-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- LT2017 changes.
-- Multiple Chapters assigned to a single user.
DECLARE
 l_errCode VARCHAR2(6);
 l_displayWin VARCHAR2(1);
 l_sqlQuery VARCHAR2(1000);
 l_start_pos NUMBER;
 l_end_pos NUMBER;
 lt_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 l_chp_name VARCHAR2(400);
 list_id ITEM;
BEGIN
 l_start_pos := INSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, '[');
 l_end_pos := INSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, ']');
 
 SELECT SUBSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, (l_start_pos+1), l_end_pos-(l_start_pos+1)) INTO lt_user_id FROM DUAL;
 

 check_user_chapters(p_userID => lt_user_id,
 p_errCode => l_errCode,
 p_displayWin => l_displayWin);
 
 
 IF l_errCode IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 show_error(l_errCode);
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name', ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 
 l_sqlQuery := 'select chptr.chapter_name || '' ('' || chptr.chapter_id || '')'',
 chptr.chapter_name || '' ('' || chptr.chapter_id || '')''
 from valid_user_chapters vuc, chapters chptr
 where vuc.chapter_id = chptr.chapter_id
 and UPPER(user_id) = ''' || lt_user_id || '''
 and sysdate between vuc.eff_date and nvl(vuc.term_date, sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between chptr.eff_date and nvl(chptr.term_date, sysdate+1)'; 
 
 IF l_displayWin = 'N' THEN
 l_sqlQuery := l_sqlQuery || ' and NVL(vuc.default_flag, ''Y'') = ''Y''';
 END IF;
 
 gen_LoV(p_rgName => 'user_chp_rg1',
 p_listItem => 'lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name',
 p_sqlQuery => l_sqlQuery
 );
 
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 al_id ALERT;
 al_text VARCHAR2(80);
 al_button NUMBER;
 lt_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 l_start_pos NUMBER;
 l_end_pos NUMBER;
begin
 
 
 IF :lt_users_ctrl.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 go_item('DUAL.CONNECT_BUTTON');
 l_start_pos := INSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, '[');
 l_end_pos := INSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, ']');
 
 SELECT SUBSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.user_id, (l_start_pos+1), l_end_pos-(l_start_pos+1)) 
 INTO lt_user_id 
 FROM DUAL;

 IF login_core.is_user_expired(lt_user_id)THEN
 password_message (globalvar.err_not_authorized); -- 'You are not authorized to access the system';
 EXIT_BC_APP(lt_user_id, globalvar.err_not_authorized);
 END IF;
 IF login_core.is_user_locked(lt_user_id) THEN
 password_message(globalvar.err_user_is_locked); --'ERR: 16314 Application User is locked, password attempts exceeds.');
 EXIT_BC_APP(lt_user_id, globalvar.err_user_is_locked); 
 END IF;
 -- SCR 20552; Commented out on 05/05/2014; 
 -- Network user password will be used aslifetrak password. Dropping reset password functionality for AD enabled scenarios.
 -- is_user_reset_request(lt_user_id); -- SCR 20552; Commented out on 05/05/2014; 
 -- check_strong_password_age; -- SCR 20552; Commented out on 05/05/2014;
 -- 
 IF :lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id := SUBSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name, INSTR(:lt_users_ctrl.chapter_name,'(')+1, 3); 
 
 select testing_lab_code
 into :global.user_testing_lab_code
 from system_users
 where user_id = lt_user_id;
 
 UPDATE system_users
 SET chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 WHERE user_id = lt_user_id;
 END IF;

 LOGIN_CORE.log_login_event(app_user => :DUAL.UN,
 workstation => GLOBALVAR.workstation,
 audit_event => 'Successful Login - AD Enabled');
 
 -- LT2013R2 - SCR 20552 - 04232014
 DECLARE
 CURSOR app_user_cur IS
 SELECT user_id
 FROM system_users
 WHERE UPPER(ad_user_id) = UPPER(:DUAL.UN)
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1);
 BEGIN
 FOR app_user_rec IN app_user_cur
 LOOP -- Loop through each app user linked with a single network user.
 IF NOT lt_password_policy.check_hash ( app_user_rec.user_id, :DUAL.PW) THEN -- Update only when the passwords do not match.
 update_ltuser_pwd(app_user_rec.user_id);
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 
 END; 
 -------------- End Change.
 lt_user_session.set_userid (lt_user_id); -- V19, SCR 19807
 get_session; 
 
 CALL_MENU_FORM;
 ELSE
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('Error_Alert');
 al_text := 'Please Select User ID';
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,al_text ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 END IF;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ERR_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Added on 02/08/2013 SCR 19807;
 -- Simple function to retrieve error message.
 
 -- Used to retrieve AD errors when connected to db and stores them 
 -- in globalvar pkg error variables for later user.
*/

FUNCTION err_msg(err_code_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 CURSOR error_cur IS 
 SELECT error 
 FROM valid_errors
 WHERE error_code = err_code_in; 
BEGIN
 l_err_msg := NULL;
 OPEN error_cur;
 FETCH error_cur INTO l_err_msg;
 CLOSE error_cur;
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NULL THEN
 l_err_msg:= 'Err: No error description for error code ' || err_code_in;
 ELSE
 l_err_msg := 'Err:' || err_code_in ||': '|| l_err_msg;
 END IF; 
 
 RETURN l_err_msg;
END err_msg;

PROCEDURE set_lt_users IS 
 rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := 'lt_users_rg'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 list_id item := FIND_ITEM('LT_USERS_CTRL.USER_ID');
 errcode NUMBER; 
 sql_query VARCHAR2(1000) := 'SELECT INITCAP(user_first_name) || '' '' || INITCAP(user_last_name) || '' '' || ''['' || user_id || '']'', 
 INITCAP(user_first_name) || '' '' || INITCAP(user_last_name) || '' '' || ''['' || user_id || '']''
 FROM system_users
 WHERE UPPER(ad_user_id) = UPPER(:DUAL.UN)
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1)';
 l_cnt NUMBER; 
 the_rowcount NUMBER; 
BEGIN 
 /* 
 ** Make sure group doesn't already exist 
 */ 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name );
 /* 
 ** If it does not exist, create it and add the two 
 ** necessary columns to it. 
 */ 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, sql_query);
 END IF; 
 /* 
 ** Populate the record group 
 */ 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 
/* 
 IF errcode = 0 THEN

 PASSWORD_MESSAGE('The query retrieved '||to_CHAR(the_rowcount)|| 
 ' record(s)'); 
 ELSE 
 PASSWORD_MESSAGE('Error creating query record group.'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
*/

 CLEAR_LIST(list_id); 
 POPULATE_LIST (list_id, rg_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_USER_CHAPTERS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_user_chapters(p_userID IN VARCHAR2, 
 p_errCode OUT VARCHAR2,
 p_displayWin OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 l_chp_cnt NUMBER;
 l_defChp_cnt NUMBER;
 l_chpID VARCHAR2(10);
 
 CURSOR chp_cnt_cur IS
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 FROM valid_user_chapters vuc, chapters chp
 WHERE vuc.chapter_id = chp.chapter_id
 AND vuc.user_id = p_userID
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(vuc.chapter_id, SYSDATE) BETWEEN vuc.eff_date AND NVL(vuc.term_date, SYSDATE+365) -- MLT 1084
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN chp.eff_date AND NVL(chp.term_date, SYSDATE+365);
 
 CURSOR defChp_cnt_cur is
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 FROM valid_user_chapters vuc, chapters chp
 WHERE vuc.chapter_id = chp.chapter_id
 AND vuc.user_id = p_userID
 AND NVL(default_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(vuc.chapter_id, SYSDATE) BETWEEN vuc.eff_date AND NVL(vuc.term_date, SYSDATE+365) -- MLT 1084
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN chp.eff_date AND NVL(chp.term_date, SYSDATE+1);
 
 CURSOR defChp_cur IS
 SELECT vuc.chapter_id
 FROM valid_user_chapters vuc, chapters chp
 WHERE vuc.chapter_id = chp.chapter_id
 AND vuc.user_id = p_userID
 AND NVL(default_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(vuc.chapter_id, SYSDATE) BETWEEN vuc.eff_date AND NVL(vuc.term_date, SYSDATE+365) -- MLT 1084
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN chp.eff_date AND NVL(chp.term_date, SYSDATE+1); 
 
 PROCEDURE upd_userChp(in_chpID VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 UPDATE system_users
 SET chapter_id = in_chpID
 WHERE user_id = p_userID;
 
 -- Set user access class; -- V06
 UPDATE valid_user_access_classes 
 SET CHAPTER_ID = in_chpID
 WHERE USER_ID= p_userID; 
 END upd_userChp;
BEGIN
 p_errCode := NULL;
 p_displayWin := 'N';

 
 -- No. of chapters associated with the user.
 OPEN chp_cnt_cur;
 FETCH chp_cnt_cur INTO l_chp_cnt;
 CLOSE chp_cnt_cur; 
 
 IF l_chp_cnt = 0 THEN
 p_errCode := '0130';
 --- Error --- need to have atleast one chapter ID associated with user.
 ELSE
 -- Default chapter count (should be either 1 or 0)
 OPEN defChp_cnt_cur;
 FETCH defChp_cnt_cur INTO l_defChp_cnt;
 CLOSE defChp_cnt_cur;

 -- Get the Default Chapter ID.
 OPEN defChp_cur;
 FETCH defChp_cur INTO l_chpID;
 CLOSE defChp_cur; 

 IF l_defChp_cnt = 0 THEN -- defualt chapter is not set
 IF l_chp_cnt = 1 THEN

 -- Update system users table with the default chapter id.
 upd_userChp(l_chpID);
 
 -- Do not display multiple Chapters window;
 p_displayWin := 'N';
 ElSE
 -- Display multiple Chapters window
 p_displayWin := 'Y';
 END IF;
 ELSIF l_defChp_cnt = 1 THEN -- defualt chapter is set
 -- Do not display window
 p_displayWin := 'N';
 
 -- Update system users table with the default chapter id.
 upd_userChp(l_chpID); 
 ELSE -- Multiple chapters set as default.
 message('Multiple chapters are set as default for the user');
 p_errCode := 'XXXX';
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;

END check_user_chapters;

PROCEDURE SET_APPL_GLOBAL IS
BEGIN
/* This was created in LT2013R3 - as part of IM 15 - global.tz_enabled and global.tz_offset variables are set here and will be used across the whole applicaton.
 These two global variables are passed to the routine lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.TZ_ENABLED, :GLOBAL.TZ_OFFSET, GMT_TIME). 
 This routine was added to replace original timezone performance intensive function.
*/
 
 :GLOBAL.single_user := 'Y'; -- Only option that is supported.
 
 :GLOBAL.tz_enabled := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset := '';
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.warehouse := '';
 
 
 -- global.tz_enabled variable is set here.
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 :GLOBAL.tz_enabled := 'Y';
 END IF;
 -- 
 
 -- global.tz_offset variable is set here.
 begin
 select ch.time_zone, ch.chapter_id, su.warehouse_id 
 into :GLOBAL.tz_offset, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse
 from system_users su, chapters ch
 where UPPER(su.user_id) = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid and
 su.chapter_id = ch.chapter_id and
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(su.chapter_id, SYSDATE) between ch.eff_date and nvl(ch.term_date,sysdate+365); -- MLT 1084
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting chapter_id for user');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 
 
 -- Set lt_user_session variables. -- LT2018
 lt_user_session.set_chapter_id(:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 lt_user_session.set_warehouse_id(:GLOBAL.warehouse);
 lt_user_session.set_tzone_flag(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled);
 lt_user_session.set_tzone_offset(:GLOBAL.tz_offset);
 
END;

 PROCEDURE call_DE_cmd(cmd_in IN VARCHAR2, error_code OUT VARCHAR2, error_msg OUT VARCHAR2) IS

 KTrak_Interface.call_api_cmd (

 End If;

 NULL;

 error_code := '94XX';
 error_msg := sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,200);
 END;

 PROCEDURE CALL_RIS_CMD(cmd_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 v_url VARCHAR2(2000);

 v_errmsg VARCHAR2(2000);

 in_cmd => cmd_in,
 out_string => v_url,

 out_errmsg => v_errmsg 
 );

 -- Error Code: 94XX is used as internal code and is not defined in error codes definition.

 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else

 globalvar.g_kt_doc_url := v_url;
 Elsif UPPER(cmd_in) = 'ALERTS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_alert_url := v_url;
 Elsif UPPER(cmd_in) = 'ASSIGNMENTS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_assg_url := v_url; 
 End If;
 
 EXCEPTION
 When Form_trigger_failure then
 raise;
 
 When others then
 message(sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,200));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END;

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 v_err_code VARCHAR2(100);

 exit_process EXCEPTION;
 BEGIN
 --IF KTRAK.IS_Integrated THEN 

 KTRAK.call_DE_cmd('UserStatus', v_err_code, v_err_msg); 
 
 If v_err_code is null then
 -- Check if any errors are returned in XML data.

 If globalvar.g_kt_error is not null then
 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('D');

 check_package_failure;
 Else

 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('E');

 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('D');
 NEW_FORM ('ltismenu');

 End If;
 Else

 -- Error Code: 94XX is used as internal code and is not defined in error codes definition.

 message('Internal Error - ' || v_err_msg || ' KnowledgeTrak is disabled');
 raise exit_process;
 elsif v_err_code in ('9400', '9403') then -- 9403: User does not have permission; 9400: KT User ID is not configured.
 show_error(v_err_code, ' KnowledgeTrak is disabled');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 --show_error(v_err_code, v_err_msg); -- IM:9762
 show_error(v_err_code); -- IM:9762
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End If;
 --ELSE
 --Enable_Disable('D'); -- Added on 01/31/2012; Ashok 
 --END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN exit_process then
 NULL;
 END initialize; 
END;

 hashing := LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.SAVE_HASH(:DUAL.PW);
 
 UPDATE system_users
 SET reset_request = 'N',
 password_modified_date = SYSDATE,
 lifetrak_password = hashing
 WHERE user_id = lt_user_in;
 
 UPDATE lt_password_history

 INSERT INTO lt_password_history

 hashing,
 SYSDATE,

 );
 COMMIT;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t timer;
 timer_id Timer ;
 
begin
 t := Create_Timer( 'web', 500, NO_REPEAT ) ;
 timer_id := Create_Timer( 'laf_timer', 100, NO_REPEAT ) ;
End ;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 lb$ok BOOLEAN;
 n NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF LOWER (GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY (timer_name)) = 'web' THEN
 initialise_windows;
 END IF;
 
 IF LOWER (GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY (timer_name)) = 'laf_timer' THEN
 IF pkg_look_and_feel.open_css (:parameter.pm$css_filename) THEN
 IF :parameter.pm$gui IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- read the global GUI properties --
 pkg_look_and_feel.set_gui_properties (:parameter.pm$gui,
 'LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN'
 );
 pkg_look_and_feel.set_gui_properties (:parameter.pm$gui,
 'LAF_BLOCK.CAC'
 );
 END IF;

 -- paint the canevases --
 IF :parameter.pm$canvas IS NOT NULL THEN
 pkg_look_and_feel.paint_canevas (:parameter.pm$canvas,
 'LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN'
 );
 END IF;

 IF :parameter.pm$cac_canvas IS NOT NULL THEN
 pkg_look_and_feel.paint_canevas (:parameter.pm$cac_canvas,
 'LAF_BLOCK.CAC'
 );
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
END;
